case_name: Rajendra Shantaram Todankar v State of Maharashtra and others

statutes.act: Ipc Merely Because A Criminal Act

facts: Eight accused persons were tried on several charges framed under Sections 143, 144, 147, 302, 302/149, 302/34, 307, 307/149, 307/34, 324, 324/149, 324/34 and 324/511 IPC.
The accused persons were residents of two localities, Hatiskar Wadi and Nariman Bhat Nagar, and were known to each other since before the incident.

Prior to this incident on the festival of Janmashtami there was a competitive game played known as Dahi Handi, also known as 'Govinda', wherein both the gangs had participated and quarrelled with each other.
The present incident took place on 27th September, 1991 at about 8.30 p.m.
Gopikrishna, who died in the incident, was standing in front of the entrance door of the building.
Sanjay Patil, PW1 saw all the eight appellants coming towards the hotel and then they opened an assault on all the three persons standing there.
The accused persons chased Gopikrishna and injured him fatally. He fell down in a pool of blood on the landing of the fourth floor.
Sanjay, PW1 picked up a taxi and proceeded to KEM hospital for medical help and treatment.
issues: Whether all the accused persons were involved in the incident?
To what extent were the accused persons involved in the incident?
What was the nature of the guilt attributable to the accused persons?
petitioner_arguments: The prosecution case hinges upon the testimony of four witnesses, namely, Sanjay Patil (PW-1), Jaideep (P-3), Dyandeo Sawant (PW-4) and Prashant (PW-5).
We will analyse the testimony of these four witnesses so as to find out the nature of the offence committed and the involvement of the accused persons.
respondent_arguments: There is no material available on record to hold that the deceased Gopikrishna and the injured Sanjay Patil had anything to do with each other or the common object of the alleged unlawful assembly of eight persons was to cause the death of Gopikrishna as also to cause injuries to Sanjay Patil.
court_reasoning: A careful reading of the testimony of the eyewitnesses reveals that while accused Nos. 1 to 5 assaulted the deceased Gopikrishna, the other three accused persons have allegedly participated in assault on Sanjay Patil.
We are referring to assault by three accused persons, namely, accused Nos. 6 to 8 on Sanjay Patil.
holding: The appeal surviving for decision as regards the six accused was held liable to be dismissed upholding the conviction as recorded and the sentences as passed by the Trial Court.
cases_cited: Rajendra Shantaram Todankar v State of Maharashtra
